title: That app is so good it feels illegal
author: mishelzZ
selftext:
I just met that app from a Facebook ad called Graphist.ai that you capture the screenshot of a trading chart and get trading plans for educational purposes , the fact that I made money from a good plan that he just told me to go for based on its technical analysis patterns is amazing

I used ChatGPT for a while but it always got messy and too much text and not accurate at all  
It’s like Graphist is using all the models to give me the best trading plan so I can learn from a second opinion .

I seriously wanted to go short on NQ but it said long and I went long on the 5 min chart and actually made 1000 dollar withdraw the same month

It feels so illegal and not many people know it I wonder why they don’t start marketing already

Anybody finds it useful? I feel like it’s a money printer and not like all the algo trading out there that has their own risks , this one is just like a 10 men team of analysts in your own pocket and it got more things there not only technical analysis

I hope this owner of Graphist.ai sees that and will update soon the app, last update was last week so I guess he is cooking it to be better soon, if you see this, do know that I liked the design the non complexity of your app! Well played!!
